title: Security
subtitle: Two-factor authentication, password and recent activity.

neverAsk.title: We never ask for your secrets
neverAsk.text: Ledgerline staff never ask for your password, two-factor codes, private keys or seed phrase — by email, chat or phone.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.onText: A code from your authenticator app is needed to sign in and for sensitive actions.
mfa.offText: Turn it on to protect your account. It is required to add withdrawal addresses and to withdraw.
mfa.verifiedSession: This session is verified with your second factor.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app, such as one from your phone's app store.
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.backupWarning: If you lose the device, you will need support to recover access. Keep the key above somewhere safe and offline.
mfa.disableWarning: Without it you cannot add addresses or withdraw, and your account is easier to take over.
mfa.disableText: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
password.signsOut: Changing your password signs out every other device.

eventsHint: If you do not recognise something here, change your password and contact support.

events.recovery: Account recovered with a reset link
